article.headline: NFL Suspends Rams Star Puka Nacua for Three Games Over Personal Conduct
article.summary: The NFL suspended wide receiver Puka Nacua for three games after he violated the league's personal-conduct policy.
article.body: Puka Nacua, 25, faces the NFL suspension while already on injured reserve following a right knee sprain sustained during the final offensive play against the Washington Commanders on Nov. 8. The wide receiver will be officially reinstated from the suspension on Dec. 14, though his eligibility to return from injured reserve does not begin until the Dec. 20 game against the Dallas Cowboys. According to the Los Angeles Times, Nacua is the defendant in a civil lawsuit involving allegations of an antisemitic remark and physical assault. The league announced the three-game suspension without pay on Thursday. Nacua has recorded 70 receptions for 715 yards and four touchdowns throughout the current season. This suspension coincides with his recovery period, meaning the Rams' immediate roster plans remain unchanged. The team will shift its passing focus toward Konata Mumpfield while Nacua continues to serve his time away from the field. Before these off-the-field incidents, Nacua was widely considered a candidate for a significant contract extension in the final year of his rookie deal. He previously checked himself into a rehab facility during the spring and participated in offseason workouts. During training camp, Nacua stated he was attempting to take accountability for his actions to facilitate personal growth. The suspension effectively keeps the star receiver sidelined beyond his initial injury timeline as he prepares for a potential return late in December.

article.headline: Undefeated Alexander Zverev Clinches Top Seed Spot in ATP Finals Group Play
article.summary: Alexander Zverev enters the ATP Finals semifinals as the undefeated group winner following his dominant performance in Turin.
article.body:
Alexander Zverev secured his place in the semifinals with a flawless run, winning 25 consecutive points behind his serve during a straight-sets victory against Ben Shelton. The German powerhouse dominated the court with 14 aces, maintaining an unbeaten record that ensures his position as the top seed emerging from the John McEnroe Group.

This performance highlights Zverev's dominance, though his recent match faced scrutiny regarding match flow and court speed. While Zverev secured his spot, other players remain in contention, as Ben Shelton’s advancement now hinges on Zverev's performance against Arthur Fils. If Zverev defeats Fils on Thursday, Shelton will earn his first-ever appearance in the tournament's final four.

According to the BBC, Zverev is already confirmed to face either Daniil Medvedev or Frances Tiafoe in Saturday's semifinals. Yahoo Sports reports that the tournament is hosted at the Inalpi Arena, which is contracted to serve as the venue for the ATP Finals through 2027. Despite the statistical success of the top-ranked players, the speed of the indoor hard courts has prompted significant feedback from fans regarding the frequency of short points and total active play time during these high-stakes matchups.

Zverev now looks toward his next challenge on Thursday, where his result will decide the final composition of the semifinal bracket. Having already clinched the top group position, he enters that match as the definitive leader of the season-ending tournament field.

article.headline: زد يصطدم بسموحة في ليلة حسم بطاقة التأهل لربع نهائي الكأس
article.summary: يواجه فريق زد نظيره سموحة في الثامنة من مساء اليوم الخميس على استاد القاهرة الدولي ضمن منافسات دور الـ 16 بكأس مصر.
article.body:
يخوض فريقا زد وسموحة مواجهة لا تقبل القسمة على اثنين، حيث يسعى كل طرف لانتزاع بطاقة التأهل إلى الدور ربع النهائي من بطولة كأس مصر للموسم الحالي 2026-2027. وتأتي هذه المواجهة في ظل تطلعات كبيرة من كلا الفريقين لمواصلة المشوار في المسابقة، حيث يعول زد على استمرار عروضه الهجومية القوية بعدما نجح في الدور السابق بتسجيل خماسية في شباك سمنود، بينما يراهن فريق سموحة على خبراته لتجاوز هذا الاختبار الصعب والوصول إلى الأدوار المتقدمة.

تكمن أهمية المباراة في كونها فرصة لمواصلة المنافسة على لقب كأس مصر، وهو ما يجعل اللقاء خارج التوقعات في ظل رغبة الطرفين في الفوز وحجز مقعد في الدور التالي. ومن المتوقع أن تشهد المباراة حضوراً تقنياً لافتاً، حيث قرر الاتحاد المصري لكرة القدم تطبيق تقنية حكم الفيديو المساعد "VAR" في جميع مباريات دور الـ 16، وذلك لضمان العدالة التحكيمية وتقليل الأخطاء المؤثرة في نتائج المواجهات، وهي خطوة تعزز من أهمية الحدث مقارنة بدور الـ 32 الذي غابت فيه هذه التقنية.

من جانبه، استعد سموحة للقاء بقائمة أعلنها المدير الفني أحمد عبد العزيز، تضم تشكيلة من اللاعبين في مختلف الخطوط، يتقدمهم في حراسة المرمى أحمد ميهوب، وحسين تيمور، ومحمد حيدر، مع تواجد عناصر دفاعية ووسط ميدان مثل عمرو السيسي ومحمد مكرونة، وذلك بعد نجاح الفريق في حجز مقعده بهذا الدور عقب الفوز على المنيا بهدفين نظيفين. ويترقب عشاق كرة القدم المصرية صافرة البداية في الثامنة من مساء اليوم على استاد القاهرة الدولي لحسم المتأهل رسمياً إلى ربع النهائي.

news.og_title: Gold Edges up from 14-month Low as Markets Assess Fed Rate Outlook
news.og_desc: Gold prices ticked up on Thursday, after hitting a more-than-one-year low earlier in the session amid growing US interest rate hike bets, while investors looked to Federal Reserve commentary for fresh signals on monetary policy. Spot gold rose 0.3% to $3,733.76 per ounce by 0630 GMT, after hitting its lowest level since September 2025 at $3,693.13 per ounce earlier in the session. US gold futures for December delivery fell 0.1% to $3,737.20.
